APPROVED_OPERATIONAL_REQUIREMENTS: Lifecycle: allow `ModifyDBInstance` only while status is `AVAILABLE`; allocated storage must strictly increase; reject `DeleteDBInstance` when `DeletionProtection` is true even if a final snapshot id is supplied; on reboot, reload config, apply pending static parameters, and clear `pending_reboot_parameters` only after boot validation succeeds.

WAL / PITR: ingest archives with timeline and sequence continuity (flag gaps); bind base-backup LSN/timeline; partially replay WAL to the restore target; accept targets only when `EarliestRestorableTime <= target <= LatestRestorableTime`.

Parameter groups: apply dynamic parameters immediately, mark static ones pending reboot, merge overrides into family defaults; `ResetDBParameterGroup` sets attached instances to `parameter_group_status=pending-reboot` and `pending_reboot_parameters=true`.

Promotion: require `replication_lag_bytes <= MaximumAllowedLagBytes` (10485760) and LSN catch-up; revoke the old primary write lease and mark that former primary `READ_ONLY`; then atomically swap writer/reader endpoints. Promotion must not flush VIP routes or send gratuitous ARP (those steps are failover-only).

Failover: acquire a TTL-fenced leader lease first; decide health from direct DB TCP reachability (ignore control-plane pool lag alone); on floating VIP migration flush routes, send gratuitous ARP, and record evidence per the failover contract.

Outbox / isolation: enqueue EventBridge rows in the same DB transaction as instance state changes; match subscriptions by `SourceType` and event category; use deterministic `EventIdentifier` hashes; write `event_delivery_audit` after max retries; enforce account, region, and `tenant_id` isolation on describe/list projections.

Outputs: publish `/app/rds/out/rds-snapshot.json` with canonical sorted keys and `report_digest` over the stable field subset defined in the operator contract; also emit UTF-8 `/app/rds/out/instances.jsonl`, `/app/rds/out/events.jsonl`, and `/app/rds/out/health.json` (companions are required artifacts; they do not carry digests and are not separately graded for line/key ordering beyond existing as well-formed UTF-8 JSON/JSONL).

BEHAVIORAL_SURFACES: DBInstance modification requests enforce status = AVAILABLE before processing changes
Allocated storage changes validate new size is strictly greater than current allocated storage
DeletionProtection = true rejects DeleteDBInstance calls regardless of final snapshot settings
RebootDBInstance with pending static parameters reloads configuration and applies parameters
WAL segment ingestion validates sequence continuity, timeline ID, and flags archive gaps
Point-in-Time Recovery synthesizes exact target timestamp using partial WAL replay
Snapshot restore validates redo_lsn and timeline_id compatibility with base backup
RestoreDBInstanceToPointInTime enforces target timestamp within restorable retention window
ModifyDBParameterGroup with static parameters sets PendingRebootParameters without immediate apply
DBParameterGroup merges instance-specific parameter overrides with default family parameters
PendingRebootParameters flag is cleared only after all modified static parameters pass boot validation
ResetDBParameterGroup sets instance parameter_group_status to pending-reboot
PromoteReadReplica checks replication lag is within MaximumAllowedLagBytes and not UNKNOWN
Replica promotion waits for flush_lsn to reach primary write_lsn before declaring primary
Replica promotion revokes write lease on old primary to prevent split-brain dual primary
Replica promotion updates read and write endpoints atomically in DNS/routing table
Automatic Multi-AZ failover requires lease expiration or leader lease acquisition before failover
Multi-AZ failover fencing prevents standby promotion while former primary lease is valid
Health probe evaluator distinguishes direct instance port probe from control plane DB connection pool lag
VIP migration during failover flushes route tables and issues gratuitous ARP announcements
Outbox events are enqueued inside the same database transaction as instance state changes
EventBridge subscriptions filter events by SourceType and SourceIdentifier correctly
Event notification retries reuse deterministic EventIdentifier hashes to prevent duplicates
Failed event deliveries record failure evidence in event_delivery_audit on max retries
Instance status transitions write atomic transaction WAL checkpoints before DB commit
Control plane restart checks transaction checkpoints to skip completed operations and PITR restores
Instance describe and list APIs enforce multi-tenant account, region, and tenant_id isolation
State snapshot reports format canonical JSON with sorted keys for stable SHA-256 digest calculation
Readiness status reports READY only when all instances, replication links, and outbox queues are healthy
Identical control plane runs produce identical report digests
